articles.headline: XRP ETFs see inflows for 13th week; Bitcoin, Et...
articles.description: U.S.-listed XRP ETFs continued their inflow streak for the 13th consecutive week ending Oct. 9, attracting $11.31 million and raising cumulative inflows to $1.80 billion. Meanwhile, Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana ETFs experienced significant outflows totaling nearly $1.25 billion, with Bitcoin funds withdrawing $681.10 million, Ethereum $542.07 million, and Solana $24.81 million. This marks a reversal for Bitcoin after three weeks of inflows, consistent withdrawals for Ethereum over five sessions, and the end of a 14-week inflow streak for Solana. Despite XRP's inflows, total net assets for XRP ETFs declined to $1.57 billion. These flows reflect shifting investor sentiment across major crypto ETFs.

articles.headline: Why Does Ethereum Fall Harder Than Bitcoin?
articles.description: Ethereum dropped more than three times harder than Bitcoin last week, yet it also gained far less during the month's rally. Something beyond simple volatility explains why ETH keeps taking the bigger hit without delivering the bigger reward.

articles.headline: Bitcoin whale places $22.89M buy order at $82,9...
articles.description: A Bitcoin whale placed a large buy order worth $22.89 million on Binance's spot market at a price of $82,975 per BTC, totaling approximately 275.84 BTC. Initially, the order was about $8.45 million for 101.78 BTC but expanded to its current size. Around $1.86 million (22.37 BTC) of the order had been filled at the time of tracking. This order is displayed in Binance's order book but is not yet fully completed, signaling strong buying interest at this price level.
